# Which values does the type scale hold?

Read this when markup of yours needs a font family, a weight, a size, a line height or a letter spacing that no role answers.

**`--font-*`**, **`--fw-*`**, **`--fs-*`**, **`--lh-*`** and **`--ls-*`** are the type scale, and the type table below gives each one with the Tailwind utility that reads it. The table lists the families, weights, sizes, line heights and letter spacings that no role answers.

<!-- @shared typography GENERATED by bun run generate:npm-pages. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

| custom property | value | Tailwind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--font-display` | `'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif` | `font-display` |
| `--font-body` | `'Familjen Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif` | `font-body` |
| `--font-mono` | `'Spline Sans Mono',ui-monospace,monospace` | `font-mono` |
| `--fw-regular` | `400` | `font-regular` |
| `--fw-medium` | `500` | `font-medium` |
| `--fw-semibold` | `600` | `font-semibold` |
| `--fw-bold` | `700` | `font-bold` |
| `--fw-extrabold` | `800` | `font-extrabold` |
| `--fw-black` | `900` | `font-black` |
| `--fs-mega` | `9.375rem` = 150px at the browser default | `text-mega` |
| `--fs-hero` | `6rem` = 96px at the browser default | `text-hero` |
| `--fs-display` | `4rem` = 64px at the browser default | `text-display` |

| `--fs-h2` | `2rem` = 32px at the browser default | `text-h2` |
| `--fs-h3` | `1.5rem` = 24px at the browser default | `text-h3` |
| `--fs-h4` | `1.1875rem` = 19px at the browser default | `text-h4` |
| `--fs-lg` | `1.0625rem` = 17px at the browser default | `text-lg` |
| `--fs-md` | `0.9375rem` = 15px at the browser default | `text-md` |
| `--fs-sm` | `0.8125rem` = 13px at the browser default | `text-sm` |

| `--lh-root` | `1.5` | none |
| `--lh-tight` | `0.98` | `leading-tight` |
